candidateLabel: Post-Reveal 2026: confirmed counts and preliminary contention
rationale: Since the RR1 Git tag, the structured research dataset has been materially expanded and reconciled to the official Reveal Day totals. A candidate research release can now be tested without confusing a technical site update with a citable scientific archive.
evidenceLimitations: The project does not have a locally complete official ICANN APS 2026 application-level corpus.
The 2026 string inventory is a frozen secondary index; it must not be represented as a final ICANN-confirmed list.
RR1's original tag and Zenodo DOI remain immutable.
The mutable working paper is a draft, not a peer-reviewed scientific article.
Editorial Field Notes remain outside the frozen scientific corpus, even when separately linked.

publicationGate: Source-backed RR2 candidate package passes reproducibility and integrity validation.
RR2 proposed title, scientific baseline and scope are explicitly approved.
The live Zenodo GitHub integration and RR1 concept DOI/version chain are independently verified.
An RR2 GitHub Release is minted from the reviewed frozen commit, not mutable main.
Zenodo record supplies a real RR2-specific DOI and a verified version relationship to RR1.
Only after DOI verification are public CITATION.cff, scholarly index and currentResearchRelease promoted atomically.
